# Unlimited Copies Takaka

> Commercial printer and copy shop in Takaka, Tasman, New Zealand. Also offers postal courier pickup and drop-off (gold-coin fee; street address, not Rural Delivery).

- Website: https://unlimitedcopies.co.nz/
- Email: ulc@actrix.co.nz
- Phone: +64 3 525 8355
- Address: 29 Commercial Street, Takaka 7110, New Zealand
- Hours: Monday–Friday 9:00 AM – 5:00 PM; closed weekends
- Facebook: https://www.facebook.com/p/Unlimited-Copies-100050000846281/

## Services

- Digital colour and black-and-white printing
- Photocopying, scanning, laminating, finishing
- Business stationery, flyers, booklets, posters, reports
- Postal / courier pickup and drop-off point (gold coin payment for pickup use)

## Contact

Prefer email for print jobs and file attachments: ulc@actrix.co.nz
Use the contact form on the website to send a message with attachments.
